title: Raw modeler zero-copy raw-frame input fast slice
mode: local implementation and focused fast verification
scope: Make the in-memory DWG byte stream read-only so raw-modeler replay can parse the retained frame without a full mutable copy
Verify existing inline/blob/orphan replay controls and owning CTests

method.limitations: Only the existing focused replay and owning tests were run. No full suite, allocation/RSS benchmark, external peer, or native CAD application was run.

implementation.changed: Changed dwgCharStream and the in-memory dwgBuffer constructor/storage from mutable byte pointers to const byte pointers, then constructs the raw-object parser buffer directly from object.m_rawBytes.data().
lifetimeAndMutationBasis: The DRW_DwgObject instance owns m_rawBytes and outlives the entire replayRawObject parse call.
dwgCharStream::read only reads source bytes into caller-provided output memory; the stream mutates only its cursor/status.
Cloned/forked streams retain the same borrowed const pointer and are used within the same parse operation.
preserved: Body/object size and AcDs finalization checks
implementation.allocationClaim: Removes the temporary full-frame sourceFrameBytes allocation/copy; combined with the preceding parse-peer vector-copy slice, raw frame bytes are not redundantly materialized during this validation path. No wall-time or RSS improvement is claimed.
